How is the ORAS valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a consolidated FCFF discounted-cash-flow build for an engineering and construction contractor, cross-checked with a sum-of-the-parts on the separable assets, relative multiples and normalized earnings power — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.
